title: main is red: QUICK_REFERENCE.md "Current Release" still says 17.4.0 after the 17.5.0 release commit — shard-3 gate fails on main and every open PR
body:
Filed by the `repo:objectui` seat (session `session_01RnQd8iMMUwXQEV1crFmQiQ`, round 1, 2026-08-14). Duplicate-searched (semantic: QUICK_REFERENCE / current release / 17.4.0): zero open cover.

## The defect

The v17.5.0 release commit (`5bf5d2cb6`, current `origin/main`) moved every `@object-ui/*` manifest to `17.5.0` but did not update `QUICK_REFERENCE.md`'s "Current Release" block, which still states `17.4.0` (line 114). The gate built for exactly this drift — `scripts/__tests__/quick-reference-current-release-4143.test.ts` — fails with two assertions:

1. `QUICK_REFERENCE.md must state the workspace version as "17.5.0"` (line ~195);
2. the no-underived-literal sweep reports `["17.4.0"]` as a literal no manifest produced (line ~365).

## Blast radius — measured, not inferred

Test (shard 3/4) is red **on the base branch itself**, so every open PR inherits the failure regardless of its diff. Confirmed by identical signature on PR #4637, whose diff touches only `scripts/regenerate-catalog-index.py` + `examples/schema-catalog` (log pulled from job 94747819897, head `7db3160`). PRs #4638 / #4639 / #4641 show the same shard red on the same base. Until this lands, nothing in this repo can go green.

Re-check commands:
- `git grep -n "17\.4\.0" origin/main -- QUICK_REFERENCE.md` (hit at :114 ⇒ still broken)
- `git show origin/main:packages/core/package.json | grep '"version"'` (17.5.0)
- `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/quick-reference-current-release-4143.test.ts`

## Scope

Update the "Current Release" block to state `17.5.0` (and re-derive any other row the test flags). Nothing else — the gate did its job; this card is the doc catching up with the release. If other underived literals surface in the same block, fix them in the same pass per the test's derived-values list.
